images.filename: Postcard - Spreckels Lake Golden Gate Park c1904-6 San Francsico CA.jpg
images.caption:
Postcard: circa March 1904 - March 1906.  Possibly printed in Germany.  Original image probably a hand-colored black and white photograph.
The view is the northwest corner of Spreckels Lake in Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA looking north toward 36th Avenue and Fulton Street intersection on left of image with the w:Fort Miley Military Reservation/Point Lobos in the far background along the visible ridge line. Definitely pre-April 1906 Quake.  The model boats would belong to members of the San Francisco Model Yacht Club for whom the lake was built in 1902-04. Note the near-complete absence of buildings or homes in the background of the image although electric/telephone poles have already been erected along the Fulton Street corridor. (Today the area is the heavily built-up Outer Richmond, a mainly residential district of San Francisco)  
Note: The following items appear to have been added by a retouch artist to the original image.

The horse-drawn carriage.
Seated people on a 'bench.'
Unknown object in the background near the carriage.
Buildings in the image have been artistically 'enhanced' and are probably not real. 'Building' at far-left edge of image would be inside park grounds where no buildings ever existed.
slight retouching to people on left of image, especially those in background.
Aug 2013: Removed staining & spotting from scanned image, otherwise as 'found.'
Spreckels Lake, Golden Gate Park, San Francisco, CA, USA

images.caption: The Lands End Lookout at 680 Point Lobos Avenue at Lands End, was built in 2012 and was designed by EHDD in the modern style.  It has been called "San Francisco's best work of modern architecture since the deYoung museum", and is located near the Cliff House, below Sutro Heights Park in the Golden Gate National Recreation Area, overlooking the ruins of the Sutro Baths. (Source: John King Cityscapes 2)

images.caption: The Sutro Baths was a large, privately owned public saltwater swimming pool complex in the Lands End area of the Outer Richmond District in western San Francisco, California. Built in 1896, it was located near the Cliff House, Seal Rocks, and Sutro Heights Park. The facility burned down in June 1966 and is now in ruins. The site is within the Golden Gate National Recreation Area and the Sutro Historic District.
